rationale: The discussion has shifted from repeated red lines to a more technical debate, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour and the state still insist on no closures/forced redundancies, while management, owners, and investors keep structural consolidation on the table. The analysis has clarified the economics of a deep hybrid, but no side has yet proposed a mutually acceptable package, so the process is circling around an unstable impasse rather than converging.
